why: Language phenomena the nexus ALREADY handles, where, how it is read, and whether it is reachable through a door (by kind on the pharos). Written 2026-11-27 after janus's edit-intent re-built a cruder negation and question guard beside khora's solved ones. A new organ that handles one of these phenomena must read the entry below, reuse it or say why not. Every `where` was checked by grep on the date; `by_kind` is whether a janus session reading the pharos can see the result without importing the other repo.

entries.rule: UD features Polarity=Neg or PronType=Neg on a node, never a word list; placed on the predication it attaches to
entries.note: khora readPolarity(model, rows) is not woven into the pharos; claims-from-rows gives polarity '-' on a claim; edit-intent re-applies the same two features on the EOT record

entries.phenomenon: question form (wh | polar | deliberative | statement) and what a wh-word asks for
entries.rule: UD PronType=Int, aux-first, a closed class of interrogatives and modals WITH a named giver (CGEL)
entries.note: English only; question-grammar reads the trailing '?' off the TEXT, which an EOT record does not carry; NOT woven: edit-intent can only refuse a sentence with its own subject (nsubj) as a stand-in

entries.phenomenon: coordination, relative clauses, controlled clauses, passives, copulas, years as ground
entries.rule: rows -> claims with polarity; typed gaps conj_not_expanded, unbound_pronoun, no_subject
entries.note: pure function over reader rows; not an imperative reader

entries.rule: apoha over a frozen embedding against a shuffled null; abstains below the null
entries.note: relevant to 'make it better': a word's direction is MEASURED there, not declared

entries.phenomenon: speech frames: who holds quoted or reported words
entries.rule: quote tables per codec + speech-verb act prior
